name: Golgotha
source:
You are a heretic – a religious exile, sent to the dead planet Golgotha to live out your remaining days in a commune of fellow sinners. You will never leave. But perhaps Golgotha is not quite as dead, nor as godless, as people believe...

[From [url=https://moss-thing.itch.io/golgotha]Itch.io[/url]]
